lines.t: I've been crawling through the wreckage, breathing in the smoke I made
Every lie I let consume me, pulled me deeper in the haze
But you tore into the darkness, shattered what I couldn't face
Now the fire in your whisper burns the shadows into grace
I was breaking, but you stepped into the fall
I was fading, so your voice cut through it all
And you crashed into my chaos like a raging flame
Ripping all the chains I forged from fear and pain
Every fracture in my soul, you're calling my name
Oh, you pulled me back to life again
When the darkness swore I'd never rise
Your truth hit hard and opened my eyes
I was clinging to the ruins, holding tight to every scar
But your mercy hit like thunder, splitting open who we are
In the echo of your promise, I found strength inside the ache
You rebuild me with the power, nothing in this world can break
I was breaking, but you stepped into the fall
I was fading, so your voice cut through it all
And you crash into my chaos like a raging flame
Ripping all the chains I've forged from fear and pain
Every fracture in my soul you're calling by name
Oh, you pull me back to life again
When the darkness swore I'd never rise
You truth it hard and opened my eyes
I hear you in the quiet
I hear you in the break
You pull me from the ruins
You shake the earth away
I won't run from your fire
Let it burn through everything fake
And you crash into my chaos like a raging flame
Ripping every chain I've forged from fear and pain
In the ashes of my past, you're calling my name
Oh, you pull me back to life again
When the darkness swore I'd never rise
I outfitted hard and opened my eyes
